sn10.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || Tena kho pana samayena Sukkā bhikkhunī mahatiyā parisāya parivutā dhammam deseti || || Atha kho Sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho Rājagahe rathikāya rathikam siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakam upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyam imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn10.9:2.1: Kim me katā Rājagahe manussā || madhupītā va acchare ye || Sukkam na payirūpāsanti || desentim amataṃ padaṃ || ||
sn10.9:3.1: tañca pana appaṭivānīyaṃ || asecanakam ojavaṃ || pivanti maññe sappaññā || valāhakam iva panthagūti || ||
